text: [173] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato upāsako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye katamehi pañcahi pāṇātipātī hoti .pe. surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye . pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato upāsako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge katamehi pañcahi pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti .pe. surāmeraya- majjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ saggeti .
